plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Aircraft Maintenance Technician Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 30, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7705/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 70; this seed = 2 + 17 + 17 + 17 + 17 = 70 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 2 / 17 / 17 / 17 / 17 headers. REPEATED COURSE (allow_repeated_courses): AMTP 200 Certificated Aircraft Mechanic Preparation (1 unit) is listed by the official map in Semester 1, Semester 2, Semester 3, AND Semester 4 (4 units total across the certificate) — transcribed verbatim; each instance carries the in-plan prereq AMTP 309. In-plan prereqs (all with grades of 'C' or better): AMTP 200 requires AMTP 309; AMTP 300 requires AMTP 309; AMTP 301 requires AMTP 309; AMTP 302 and 303 require AMTP 300 and 301; AMTP 304 and 305 require AMTP 302 and 303; AMTP 306 and 307 require AMTP 304 and 305; AMTP 310 and 311 require AMTP 309; AMTP 312 and 313 require AMTP 310 and 311; AMTP 314 and 315 require AMTP 312 and 313; AMTP 316 and 317 require AMTP 314 and 315; AMTP 320 and 321 require AMTP 306, 307, 316, and 317; AMTP 322 and 323 require AMTP 320 and 321; AMTP 324 and 325 require AMTP 322 and 323; AMTP 326 and 327 require AMTP 324 and 325; AMTP 330 and 331 require AMTP 306, 307, 316, and 317; AMTP 332 and 333 require AMTP 330 and 331; AMTP 334 and 335 require AMTP 332 and 333; AMTP 336 and 337 require AMTP 334 and 335. Corequisites (documented, not modeled as prereqs — each pair is taken together in the same semester): AMTP 300 with AMTP 200; AMTP 301 with AMTP 200 and 300; AMTP 303 with AMTP 200 and 302; AMTP 305 with AMTP 200 and 304; AMTP 307 with AMTP 200 and 306; AMTP 311 with AMTP 200 and 310; AMTP 313 with AMTP 200 and 312; AMTP 315 with AMTP 200 and 314; AMTP 317 with AMTP 200 and 316; AMTP 321 with AMTP 200 and 320; AMTP 323 with AMTP 200 and 322; AMTP 325 with AMTP 200 and 324; AMTP 327 with AMTP 200 and 326; AMTP 331 with AMTP 200 and 330; AMTP 333 with AMTP 200 and 332; AMTP 335 with AMTP 200 and 334; AMTP 337 with AMTP 200 and 336. Certificate of Achievement requirements: grade of 'C' or better in each major course. Documented program enrollment eligibility: FAA English proficiency per 14 CFR 65.71; successful completion of AERO 309 or AMTP 309 with a grade of 'C' or better; Aircraft Maintenance Technician coursework completed at a different 14 CFR Part 147 institution must be evaluated via the Course Substitution Process. Aircraft Maintenance Technician, Business & Industry Meta Majors. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
